description: NaSrGaF₆ crystallizes in the orthorhombic P2_12_12₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.43 Å. Sr is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Sr-F bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.75 Å. Ga is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Ga-F bond distances ranging from 1.91-1.95 Å. There are six inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Sr, and one Ga atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sr, and one Ga atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Sr, and one Ga atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Sr and one Ga atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Sr, and one Ga atom. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Sr, and one Ga atom.
